# Money, Wealth & Markets

This is the domain map for wealth, investing, compounding, capital allocation, market cycles, and financial judgment.

## Why this matters

Money pages should help distinguish durable financial behavior from time-sensitive market claims. The vault can preserve investing ideas and market observations, but public-use or action-oriented claims need verification and context.

## Current map

| Page | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [Wealth & Market Cycles](/wiki/wealth-and-market-cycles) | Behavior, compounding, market cycles, AI bubble framing, and platform-shift discipline. |
| [Venture Opportunity Discovery](/wiki/venture-opportunity-discovery) | Opportunity selection and demand testing where market judgment overlaps with business building. |
| [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review) | Market, return, pricing, and forecast claims that should not be reused unverified. |
| [Research Leads](/wiki/research-leads) | High-quality investing, market, and economics sources to revisit. |

## Practical questions

- Which principles remain useful across cycles?
- Which claims are merely current market commentary?
- Which sources deserve rereading before money-related decisions?
- Which ideas are private thinking versus externally defensible analysis?
